why: Analysis 2 names capital-markets management of mortgage risk explicitly and states the brutal fact as the key does (the core model was an unhedged rate bet that lost, about $1M a day), with an explicit confidence statement and a more cautious Hedgehog gate. Analysis 1 has the fuller decline register (guarantees outrunning capital, earnings smoothing, loss of private status) and is slightly clearer on moving out old-model executives, but it is a little less precise on the hedgehog and brutal facts.
